transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve been a lot more on edge and kind of down. I keep snapping over little things at home, and then I go to class or the shop already feeling drained. I’m still getting by, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?

Yeah, I have. Since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve just felt more on edge than usual. Little stuff at the house sets me off, and then I go to class or the shop already feeling drained. I’m still managing, but it’s been harder to keep everything straight.
Have you been having any thoughts about not wanting to be alive or wishing you were dead?
No, I haven’t been thinking like that. I get overwhelmed and stressed, but I don’t want to die or anything like that.
Have you experienced any panic attacks since your sister and her baby moved back home?
I don’t think so. I’ve felt really stressed and wound up, but I haven’t had anything I’d call a panic attack.
Have you been having any recurring thoughts or urges that you feel compelled to repeat over and over?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that. I get stressed, but I don’t feel like I have to repeat certain thoughts or actions over and over.
Have you been enjoying things you typically like to do since your sister and her baby moved back home?

Not as much, honestly. I’m still doing things day to day, but since my sister and the baby moved back in I’ve been more on edge and kind of down. I’ve been too drained to keep up with class and the shop like usual, missed a couple deadlines, and I even backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight.
How long have you been feeling this way since your sister and her baby moved back home?
It’s been about a month now, pretty much since my sister and her baby moved back into the house.
Are there things that you used to enjoy doing, but now you don't find pleasure in them anymore?

Yeah, kind of. I used to enjoy helping with the theater set and staying on top of class and the shop, but lately I just haven’t had the same interest or energy for it. Since my sister and the baby moved back home, I’ve been more on edge and down, and I ended up backing out of the theater stuff because I couldn’t keep everything straight.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns since your sister and her baby moved back home?
I haven’t really noticed a big change with eating or sleeping. Maybe things feel a little off sometimes, but nothing that stands out to me.
Have you been avoiding certain people, places, or activities because of how you've been feeling since your sister and her baby moved back home?

Yeah, I guess I have a little. I’m still going to class and work, but I had to drop the community theater set project because I just couldn’t keep up with everything. And I’ve turned in a couple assignments late, which isn’t really like me.
Have you been avoiding social interactions or spending less time with friends since your sister and her baby moved back home?

I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve been avoiding friends on purpose. I’ve just been kind of busy and distracted, so maybe I’m not reaching out as much, but nothing major that I’ve really noticed.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight since your sister and her baby moved back home?
No, I haven’t noticed any big weight changes. My clothes fit about the same, so I don’t think so.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about things since your sister and her baby moved back home?
Not really. I mean, I feel stressed about everything sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I feel worthless or especially guilty.
Do you feel sad or down most of the day since your sister and her baby moved back home?

Yeah, I’ve been more down than usual since they moved back in. I wouldn’t say it’s nonstop all day every day, but I’m definitely more on edge and drained. I’ll show up to class or the shop already worn out, and it’s made it harder to keep up with stuff.
Do you think your stress and feeling down are directly related to your sister and her baby moving back home?

Yeah, I do think it’s directly related. It really started after my sister and the baby moved back home. Since then I’ve been more on edge and down, and I snap over small stuff around the house. Then I go to class or the shop already drained. I’m still managing, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and I backed out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight.
Have you been worrying about lots of different things lately?

I don’t know if I’d say lots of different things. It’s mostly just the stuff at home and trying to keep up with school and work. I haven’t really noticed myself worrying about everything across the board.
Have you been having any disturbing or intrusive thoughts lately?
No, not really. I mean, I get stressed and irritated, but I haven’t been having thoughts that feel disturbing or like they’re popping in and I can’t shake them.
Do you think your feelings of being on edge and down would improve if your living situation changed, such as if your sister and her baby were no longer living with you?

Yeah, I think it probably would. I mean, the situation hasn’t really changed yet—my sister and the baby are still living with us—so it’s still kind of tied to that same thing at home. If that changed, I’d expect I’d feel less on edge.
Have you experienced a significant reduction in your symptoms when you are away from home and not directly dealing with your sister and her baby?

Yeah, somewhat. When I’m away from the house, like in class or at the shop, I’m not dealing with them directly, so it can be a little easier. But I’m usually already drained from things at home, so it still affects me. I’m getting by, but I’ve missed a couple deadlines and I stopped helping with the theater set because I couldn’t keep everything straight.
